guaranteedInterval.condition: 0 <= u < exact rational lower enclosure of T_dynamic
guaranteedInterval.interpretation: The analytic theorem guarantees real simple roots throughout 0 <= v <= u.

exactPointCheck.interpretation: Exact Sturm/gcd check of this single rational-time polynomial; not a time-integrator error bound.

assumptions: Fixed finite polynomial degree at least three.
Distinct real initial roots supplied as exact rationals.
Specific heat evolution P_t = -P_zz and elapsed duration u=-t.
No interval certification of noisy or approximate root inputs is implemented.
limits: A conservative interval bound is not an exact collision predictor.
Floating-point decimals are for display; decisions compare exact fractions.
No novelty, improvement over the research literature, or RH conclusion is claimed.
